gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 explicitly identifies that Lemma a18 requires a Lagrange-polynomial bound on supp(nu), while Lemma a50 supplies a bound on supp(mu), with no assumed identification or comparison, so their direct combination cannot establish the asserted a10 rate. Its effect and repair also recognize that the general kappa/rate claim is unsupported and require tying the measures or supports.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both identify the failure of the a10 proof's direct combination because the inverse-matrix estimate uses sup norms on supp(nu) while the available a50 estimate is on supp(mu), without the hypothesis needed to transfer one bound to the other; consequently the asserted general rate is not established.

component_coverage.gold_component: The a10 theorem combines an a18 quantity controlled on supp(nu) with an a50 estimate controlled on supp(mu), but no equality, inclusion, or norm comparison is assumed, so the direct combination and resulting general rate are unsupported.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly contrasts the supp(nu) norm in a18 with the supp(mu) norm in a50, notes that the theorem's kappa/rate claim is unsupported, and proposes adding a measure/support relation to make the combination valid.
